paper_title: Constraints on Axion-like Particles from a Hard $X$-ray Observation of Betelgeuse
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, dimensionless plotted value as on y-axis
notes: ALPs produced via Primakoff in Betelgeuse core, reconverted in Galactic B-field, searched in hard X-rays with NuSTAR. Bound is essentially flat (mass-independent) below cutoff mass then rises. Quoted 95% C.L. limit g_agamma < (0.5-1.8)e-11 GeV^-1 for m_a < (5.5-3.5)e-11 eV depending on magnetic field model and stellar evolution stage. Encoded the most conservative bound (BT=0.4 uG, tcc=1.55e5 yr): g < 1.8e-11 for m_a < 3.5e-11 eV as a horizontal line. Most optimistic: 5.2e-12 GeV^-1 for m_a < 5.5e-11 eV.
